title: Spicy Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic stew originating from Algeria, made with lamb, spices, and dried fruits, perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large clay or ceramic tagine over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until it is softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the lamb and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the spice blend, salt, and pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the dried apricots and prunes, and stir to combine.
Add the chicken broth, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the tagine and transfer it to the oven.
Bake for 2.5 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs, if desired.
